headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when the AEW TNT Title changed hands as Sammy Guevara vs. Cody Rhodes battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.55 ? a war that left everything in the ring ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. In what turned out to be Cody's final match in AEW before his shock WWE return, the two traded ladder-assisted suplexes, cutters, and Cross Rhodes across a wild 22-minute war, with Guevara finally winning by cracking Cody with the title belt itself.
On this day in 2024, Komander vs. El Hijo del Vikingo vs. Kip Sabian vs. The Butcher met in a Number One Contender, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 4.87.

Back on this day in 2022, Orange Cassidy vs. Adam Cole settled things in a Lights Out match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a well-worked match ? part of that year's Beach Break '21 - Night 1.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2022, Lee Johnson returned to the fold after 7 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.
Rewind to 2022, when the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Jurassic Express vs. Private Party went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.76.

On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Jon Moxley reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Jon Moxley vs. Anthony Bowens, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 6.65 in a hard-fought men's division clash ? part of that year's Beach Break '21 - Night 2.
